title: When the Asset Falls
author: Yara Zhou
blurb: Quentin Marchetti, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
